# awavatar

> One character spec in, a rigged, animated, multi-style avatar pack out.

A generated 3D character is five artifacts from five tools (mesh, rig, clips, VRM, style renders) with no shared contract, so every host re-derives what it may load, and the bakes end up .gitignored with no canonical home -- measured 2026-09-05 on the CoC engine, where every Anny body and every clip pack is absent from disk while the code that drives them is committed.

## Install

```
pip install awavatar
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Validate one character_spec.json and one character_pack/ against their schemas and refuse the pack if any file's hash, licence or rig audit is missing.

## Composes with

- [awrtifact](https://aitherium.github.io/awrtifact/) — Deliberately chunk artifacts into GitHub release assets — the productized aitherkvcache mirror lane.
- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awsprite](https://aitherium.github.io/awsprite/) — Hatch a companion that grows only from what you teach it, then take it home.
- [awrun](https://aitherium.github.io/awrun/) — A priority-aware queue and dispatcher for agentic runs and ad-hoc CI builds. It also judges whether the runner pool is big enough for the queue it is draining, and can ask a host to grow it -- reserving capacity is zero-sum, so a saturated pool needs more of it, not a different share of it.
- [awdesk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdesk/) — Aither World Desk -- the desktop body of AitherOS Online: tray, avatars, decision cards, the Living Desktop as an overlay.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awavatar
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awavatar/

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awavatar.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
